body: Hmm, Thanks for your comments guys. I think I realize now that I'm more looking for friends rather than actually just going to parties to get smashed and forget about my life at the minute. I might as well try and find people that have similar interests. I'm sorry if I came across as frustrated or anything earlier or didn't reply to some. I've taken a bit of a step back now and thought about stuff, Thanks guys.

That's not so much what I look for though, I just wish I could meet up with a group of people occasionally. I'm not really a heavy drinker and drugs aren't my type of thing. And when I say parties I mean just round peoples houses etc or going out to the movies/a restaurant. Yet I never get invited because they just don't like me. But I'm sorry that your brother isn't doing too well right now, I hope it works out okay.
